The '''Star Fortress''' over [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] was one of many dozens, if not hundreds of [[Star Fortress]]es deployed by Emperor [[Arcann]] of the [[Eternal Empire]] to watch for possible uprisings on worlds subjugated during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. Following the [[Battle of Asylum]] and the formation of the [[Eternal Alliance|Anti-Zakuul Alliance]], a resistance cell from local [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] personnel was created on the planet, possessing significant resources and a base of operations. However, before the Alliance could deliver weapons to them, the Star Fortress vaporized the entire cell from orbit. This prompted [[Theron Shan]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] to take action against Star Fortresses, eventually destroying several of them.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bothawui Star Fortress appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' in hologram during the mission "Battle for the Stars".<ref name="SWTOR" />
